notes: Includes $9,179,138 of school-district, county and fire-district taxes the town collects on the property-tax bill and pays over to those governments (2025, the latest year the state reports). They are counted in money in and out but left out of the score, which uses the town's own budget.
Insurance, pension and social-security contributions and shared-service payments ($2,146,314) are spread across departments in proportion to their size.

Political money counts PAC, business and union contributions to candidates for South Bound Brook Borough municipal office and mayor reported to NJ ELEC since 2022-10-20. Individual donors ($0 in the same period), candidates' own committees and party committees are not counted. Small campaigns may file without itemizing, so some contributions may not appear.

Most records carry no dollar amount, so each documented program costs a quarter of the red-flag points instead of being counted as spending.
